name: NAS-Bench-201-v1_1-096897.pth
description: A serialized checkpoint/metadata file for NAS-Bench-201, a neural architecture search (NAS) benchmark that provides exhaustive performance evaluations for a fixed search space of convolutional architectures on CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet16-120. It is used to compare NAS algorithms reproducibly by providing architecture-level accuracy, training curves, and resource metrics without retraining every candidate. The benchmark enables rapid benchmarking of architecture search and performance-prediction methods.
evaluation_method: classification_accuracy (top-1) on CIFAR/ImageNet16 variants; also uses validation/test splits and resource metrics (params, FLOPs)
reputation: Widely used, standard benchmark in NAS research for reproducible evaluation and comparison of search algorithms.
